why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Marcus Semien is slot #8 (4.613 expected team runs/game).
Slots #8, #3, #7, #5, #6, #9, #4, #2, #1 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #7 ranks 3 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.000 R/G.
Slot #8 yields 3.92 expected PA/game vs 4.04 at primary slot #7. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
Offensive profile group: Balanced (exploratory unsupervised cluster — not a definitive archetype).
Cleanup (#4) models -0.001 R/G vs his average placement — typically less value than mid/lower-order spots when power/run-production profiles are modest relative to the nine.
